title: MongoDB
blurb: Documents, CRUD, querying, indexes, aggregation, transactions, schema design, replication, sharding and operations - a chapter-by-chapter companion to MongoDB: The Definitive Guide, plus PyMongo, change streams, Atlas Vector Search for RAG and interview-style data-modelling exercises.
sources: Bradshaw, Brazil & Chodorow, MongoDB: The Definitive Guide, 3rd ed. (O'Reilly, 2019), ch. 1-24
